facts.fact: Carson当面向Levi认错：年轻时的蠢错，每天都后悔
facts.anchor: “I was young, and I made a stupid mistake that I have regretted every day since. But I wish you could see that I’ve changed.”

facts.fact: Levi的指控：他只讲对自己有利的部分
facts.anchor: “He only told you the parts of the story that made him look good, while leaving out some of the most important facts.”

facts.fact: 核心真相：Carson当年向队友泄露了Levi的出柜秘密
facts.anchor: “He outed me,” Levi said, and Logan gasped.

facts.fact: 他承认：脱口说漏，立刻后悔，但伤害已造成
facts.anchor: “I blurted it out to a few of our teammates, and I instantly regretted it. But the damage was already done.”

facts.fact: 灭口手段：威胁队友曝光他们的把柄，压住消息
facts.anchor: “I threatened to tell Jumbo’s dad that he was stealing from his liquor cabinet. And Nico was selling his mom’s pain pills.”

facts.fact: 父亲当场赶Levi出门：家里不能有“这种人”
facts.anchor: “I can’t have someone like that in our home. Around my children.”

facts.fact: 更狠：父亲威胁若联系Carson就起诉他“与未成年有不正当关系”
facts.anchor: he would press charges, claiming I’d had an inappropriate relationship with his underage son.

facts.fact: 他不到一周就搬走，从此与家人断联
facts.anchor: I moved out less than a week later, and I haven’t talked to them since.

facts.fact: 她对Levi的立场：你是我兄弟，我永远爱你
facts.anchor: “You are my brother, and I will always love you.”

facts.fact: Levy的反击：你的行动不像爱我的样子
facts.anchor: “You say that, but your actions don’t feel like the actions of someone who loves me.”

facts.fact: 她为Carson辩护：不只说对的话，还在做
facts.anchor: “Carson isn’t just saying all the right things, he’s doing them.

facts.fact: Levi的羞辱：你居然为了一个男人做职业选择
facts.anchor: “I can’t believe you made a career choice based on a man.”

facts.fact: 她的反驳：这是为我自己做的决定
facts.anchor: “I made it for myself.” I jabbed my chest with my pointer finger

facts.fact: 她第一次当面宣告：我的未来包含Carson
章末：我愿你幸福、找到爱，但别是他——任何人都行，就是他不行
facts.anchor: “I love you, and I want you to be happy and find love. But not with him.” He swallowed hard, a tear sliding down his cheek. “Anyone but him.”
